changeSet.sql: IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetType' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'UseAsTransformation')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.AssetType ADD UseAsTransformation bit NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_AssetType_UseAsTransformation DEFAULT 0 WITH VALUES END
changeSet.rollback: IF ( EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetType' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'UseAsTransformation')) BEGIN ALTER table dbo.AssetType Drop CONSTRAINT DF_AssetType_UseAsTransformation ALTER table dbo.AssetType Drop Column UseAsTransformation END
